style="shape=note;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;size=12;align=left;spacingLeft=6;fontSize=11;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;" value="<b>pattern</b> is one of: weekly (chosen days of the week), monthly (a day of the month), daily.<br><b>Assumptions</b>&nbsp;:<br>A1. Availability is cut into bookable slots of slotMinutes (default 30, as in the sample CSV).<br>A2. All-or-nothing: if any new slot overlaps an existing slot of the same professional, no slot is created.<br>A3. Every slot applies at one ClinicLocation; slots imported from CSV use the default "Main Clinic".<br>A4. Minutes left over that do not fill a whole slot are not used (09:00–10:45 at 30 min gives 3 slots).<br>A5. Slots that only touch (09:00–09:30 and 09:30–10:00) do not overlap.<br>A6. Each professional exists once in the system, matched by name (the CSV has no licence number); overlaps are checked per professional." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="144" width="740" x="80" y="510" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> <diagram id="aZo83CqfhaqnyhB1-_D2" name="Page-2"> <mxGraphModel dx="994" dy="1006" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="f6xylgPXFnuawGplvL7U-1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=16;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="<b>SSD - Search Availability</b>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="940" x="-239" y="-111" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f6xylgPXFnuawGplvL7U-2" parent="1" style="shape=umlLifeline;participant=umlActor;perimeter=lifelinePerimeter;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;container=0;collapsible=0;recursiveResize=0;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=36;outlineConnect=0;portConstraint=eastwest;fontStyle=4;size=60;" value=":AdministrativeStaff" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="435" width="30" x="-121" y="-60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f6xylgPXFnuawGplvL7U-3" parent="1" style="shape=umlLifeline;perimeter=lifelinePerimeter;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;container=0;collapsible=0;recursiveResize=0;outlineConnect=0;portConstraint=eastwest;fontStyle=4;size=40;" value=":System" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="435" width="170" x="359" y="-60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f6xylgPXFnuawGplvL7U-4" parent="1" style="shape=note;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;size=12;align=left;spacingLeft=6;fontSize=11;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;" value="Context: Administrative Staff identified. A field left empty means "any";<br>empty criteria returns every open slot. Booked slots are never returned.<br>Specialty matches a slot when the slot's HealthcareProfessional has that MedSpecialty." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="56" width="740" x="-196" y="215" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
